automation_classes.AUTO_NOW: Supervisor may dispatch immediately after this pack is merged and no runtime conflict is active.
automation_classes.AUTO_AFTER_DEPENDENCY: Supervisor may dispatch when every named dependency has a durable terminal pass.
automation_classes.AUTO_NOW_STATIC_AND_AUTO_AFTER_DEPENDENC: Supervisor may dispatch static verification immediately, while runtime verification waits for the named deployment dependency.
automation_classes.CONDITIONAL_AUTO_REMEDIATION: Coordinator creates or activates only after a diagnosis names the exact root cause and scope.
automation_classes.HYBRID_HUMAN_GATE: Auto worker performs inventory, validation, ingestion, training, or evidence work, but a named human input or approval is mandatory.
automation_classes.AUTO_EVIDENCE_PLUS_HUMAN_SIGNOFF: Auto worker prepares and verifies the packet; accountable Human/Ops records the decision.
